content: Farsaaweta Woga
Yerusalaamepe yida guutha Farsaawetinne higge astamaareti Yesuusa matan shiiqidosona.
Yesuusa tamaaretape issoti issoti geeyonna kushiyan, hessika kushe meecetonna kathi meyisata be7idosona.
Farsaawetinne Ayhude asa ubbay banta aawata wogaatho banta kushiya meecetonna mookonna.
Hessadaka, enti giyape shametidaba meecconna de7ishe mokonna. Qassi enti banta aawatape ekida hara daro wogi de7ees: hessika sineta, kereta, birata miishetanne arsa meecciya wogaa naageysa.
Farsaawetinne higge astamaareti Yesuusa, “Ne tamaareti ayis aawata wogaa menthidi banta kushiya meecetonna kathi moonna?” yaagidi oychidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Isayaasi hintena cubbota,

content.text: “ ‘Haysi asay tana ba inxarsa xalaalan bonchees,
shin enta wozanay taape haahon de7ees.
Asi medhida wogaa Xoossaa higge daanisidi tamaarsiya gisho,

content: gidi xaafidaysi tuma.
“Hinte Xoossaa kiitaa aggidi asa wogaa minthidi naageta” yaagis.
Qassika Yesuusi, “Hinte hinte wogaa naagidi Xoossaa kiitaa yeggi agganaw lo77o oge demmideta.
Musey, ‘Ne aawanne ne aayiw boncha’, qassi ‘Ba aawanne ba aayiw cayeysi hayqanaw bessees’ yaagis.
Shin issi asi ba aawa woyko ba aayiw maaddanaysa aggidi, ‘Haysi taani Xoossas immida yarsho’ giiko,
I ba aawa woyko ba aayiw maaddonna mela ootheeta.
Hessadaka, hinte harata tamaarsida hinte wogan Xoossaa qaala kadhideta. Hessa mela hara darobaa ootheeta” yaagis.
Ase Tunisiyabata
Yesuusi daro asaa qassika baako xeegidi, “Ubbay taani odeysa si7itenne akeekite.
Asa wozanape keyaabay ase tuniseesipe attishin, karepe asa ulo gelidi ase tunisiyabay aybika baawa.
Si7iya haythi de7iya oonika si7o” yaagis.
Yesuusi daro asaa yeggi aggidi soo gelin iya tamaareti he leemisuwaba iya oychidosona.
I entako, “Hintewuka qassi gelibeennee? Karepe asan geliyabay aybika ase tunisanaw danda7onnaysa akeeketii?
Ayis giiko, kathi asa ulo giddo gelidi kanthidi aadhesipe attishin, asa wozana giddo gelenna” yaagis. Hessan Yesuusi kathi ubbay geeshshi gideysa erisis.
Kaallidika, Yesuusi, “Asa tunisiyabay asa wozana giddofe keyaaba.
Asa wozana giddofe keyaabay iita qofa, laymatethi, kayso, ase wodho, laame,
iita amo, iitatethi, gene, qayxe, cimo, qanaate, cashshe, otoronne boozatethi.
Ha iitabay ubbayka asa wozana giddofe keyidi ase tunisees” yaagis.
Issi Maccase Ammano
Yesuusi yaape keyidi, Xiroosa katama matan de7iya biitta bis. I issi keethi gelidi yan de7eysa oonika erana mela koybeenna. Shin qosetidi gam7anaw danda7ibeenna.
Shin I guutha na7iw tuna ayyaanay oykida issi maccasiya Yesuusaba si7ada ellesa iyako yada iya tohuwa bolla kundasu.
Iya Ayhude maccasi giduku; iya yeletiday Sirofinqe biittana. Iya, ba na7epe tuna ayyaana kessana mela Yesuusa woossasu.
Shin Yesuusi zaaridi, “Nayti koyrottidi kathaa kallo; nayta kathaa ekidi kanatas yeggeysi lo77o gidenna” yaagis.
Maccasiya zaarada, “Ta Godaw hessi tuma, shin gayta matan de7iya kanati naytape wodhiya tiifiya moosona” yaagasu.
Yesuusi qassi iiko, “Ha ne qaala gisho, ne soo ba; tuna ayyaanay ne na7epe keyis” yaagis.
Maccasiya ba soo biya wode tuna ayyaanay iipe keyin hiixan zin7idaaro demmasu.
Tullenne Muume Ura
Yesuusi Xiroosa katamaape keyidi, Sidoonaranne Tammu Katamata geetetiya biittara kanthidi Galila Abbaako bis.
Asay tullenne waayidi odetiya asi Yesuusako ehidi, ba kushiya iya bolla wothana mela iya woossidosona.
Yesuusi barka he uraa daro asape gaxa kessidi, ba biradhiya iya haythan yeddis. Qassi cuchu cuttidi iya inxarsaa bochis.
Salo pude xeellidi, tooki shempidi, “Eftah” gis. Birshethayka “Dooyeta” guussu.
Uraa haythay ellesidi dooyetis, qashetida inxarsayka birshetis, uray geeshshidi odetis.
Yesuusi asaako, “Haysa oodeska odopite” yaagis. Shin I daro minthidi odopite gin, asay odaa yaa darsis.
Hessa si7ida asa ubbay daro malaaletidi, “Ubbabaa I loythi oothees. Hari attoshin, tulliya sissees, muumiya odisees” yaagidosona.
